profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hi, my name is Mehul!

As a Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience, I specialize in backend development, API integration, and scalable architecture. Colleagues would describe me as analytical, innovative, and solution-oriented—traits that have enabled me to design robust systems, streamline deployment pipelines, and solve complex technical challenges effectively. My commitment to excellence drives my ability to deliver solutions tailored to organizational goals.

Throughout my career, I’ve collaborated on cutting-edge projects, including optimizing real-time communication systems for medical technology. Key highlights include:

• Building a Spring Boot backend for seamless WebSocket communication with 20+ devices, improving responsiveness.
• Streamlining CI/CD pipelines with Gitlab CI, reducing deployment times by 25%.
• Designing APIs using industry-standard protocols, increasing system scalability and interoperability.

I thrive on creating solutions that bridge technical complexity with user-friendly functionality. My passion for backend architecture and excellence in API development fuels my drive to continually push the boundaries of what is possible in technology. Connect with me to discuss real-time data processing, scalable system development, API design, or general industry news or updates.

I look forward to connecting with you here on LinkedIn.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built a Spring Boot backend for real-time WebSocket communication with 20+ X-Ray devices which increased responsiveness.
• Streamlined CI/CD pipelines with Gitlab CI, cutting deployment times by 25% and accelerating software releases.
• Developed APIs integrating third-party devices using industry-standard protocols which improved scalability and performance.
• Extracted telemetry data via Google BigQuery to monitor performance and support predictive maintenance.
• Partnered with product teams to prioritize backend features, resulting in a reduction in time-to-market for updates.
• Strengthened system security through data encryption protocols and adherence to compliance standards.
• Improved reliability by conducting code reviews and monitoring backend performance, boosting uptime to nearly 100%.
positions.insights: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), DICOM and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Oversaw team of 5 interns developing in JavaScript and PHP, ensuring that the project deadlines were met
• Utilized Google APIs to create the functionality that displays amenities of a town asynchronously, allowing for additional information to be seen while decreasing average loading time by 3 seconds
• Assisted the QA team with efficiently logging and fixing bugs that occurred in daily builds of the product, providing performance enhancements, and minimizing security risks by 18%
• Collaborated with multiple developers to divide the project into smaller increments, optimizing efficiency by 10%
• Developed Python scripts that estimate monthly budgets, granting users the ability to assess home affordability

positions.title: Print and Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
• Assessed the needs of customers and recommended various mediums to print on, ensuring that the optimal print options were utilized, improving customer satisfaction by 30%
• Developed and maintained relationships with various business and personal clients, increasing the number of reoccurring customers by 13%
• Resolved print-related technical difficulties and created protocols to prevent future issues from occurring by 20%

projects.title: Cryptocurrency Price Bot
projects.description:
Fetches price for the cryptocurrency user asked for.
The bot is used in a Discord Server

projects.title: Photo Display
projects.description:
Software to create Digital Photo Frame
Each piece of software is containerized using Docker
